diagnostic_disclosure.purpose: freeze a finite canonical family after mechanism discovery; only 2025 H1 and H2 remain binding

dynamic_portfolio_contract.B02_rule: B02 entries and exits remain unchanged except that F05 candidate exits can change whether B02/F05 positions are active around later entries; only the F05 candidate decision uses the dynamic state
dynamic_portfolio_contract.candidate_exit_effect: a position closed by this family is absent from every later entry-state calculation
dynamic_portfolio_contract.equivalence_signature: same changed trade keys, exit checkpoint and candidate P/L; exposure label differences alone do not split an equivalence class
dynamic_portfolio_contract.same_timestamp_rule: all unchanged entries sharing the timestamp are simultaneous peers; candidate exits scheduled at that timestamp are processed before those entries
dynamic_portfolio_contract.state_at_entry: recompute from positions whose candidate-adjusted close time is strictly after the new entry time

mechanisms.rule: when pips_30m <= -A and pips_60m <= -B, close at 60 minutes only for unsupported entry states; leave same-direction-supported positions unchanged
apply the E1 60-minute unsupported exit; for same-direction-supported positions with the same initial adverse condition, close at 90 minutes when pips_90m <= -C and pips_90m - pips_60m <= R

canonical_representative_rule: prefer A=15 over A=10 or A=20 when tied because it preserves the diagnosed deep-adverse threshold
prefer B=5 when tied because it is the weakest persistence confirmation
prefer C equal to A when the threshold labels are behaviorally equivalent
prefer R=0 when tied because it expresses literal no-recovery without tolerance
parameter_equivalence.definition: same changed trade keys, same exit checkpoint, and same candidate P/L for every 2024 position

processing_order: at each M15 bar open apply the normal fixed-time-cap exit first
for still-open F05 positions calculate exact age and executable marked P/L
at 60 minutes evaluate the frozen initial adverse condition
if the initial condition is true and entry state is unsupported close at the 60-minute executable price
if the initial condition is true and entry state is same-direction-supported defer the decision
at 90 minutes close the deferred position only when the 90-minute adverse and recovery conditions are true
evaluate new B02 and F05 entries only after all exits
prohibited: changing the 63-cell family after canonical reproduction
adding a signal or volatility exemption from the single harmed winner
combining with closed S1 S2 S3 Family C or D candidates
using 2025 H1 or H2 to choose thresholds
executing candidate-specific 2025 evidence before exact MT4 parity
ranking_order: minimum of H1 and H2 ex-best-two-entry-date delta descending
minimum of H1 and H2 leave-one-month-out delta descending

diagnostic_rows.materialization: retained in the immutable analysis packet; diagnostic findings are recorded in docs/research/usdjpy_2024_full_year_recovery_path_diagnostic_v1.md

prior_candidate_union.materialization: derived from the frozen H1/H2 changed-trade evidence for S1, S2, S3 and Family C; exact source identities are bound in the source manifest

recovery_population.materialization: deterministically derived from the frozen H1 Entry-State Atlas and H2 Rakuten MT4 audit; exact reconstruction is required in the 2024 MT4 parity workflow

supersedes.reason: the v1 evaluator used baseline-static entry exposure labels even though candidate exits can alter active positions for later entries
